subject: math
cluster: Represent and solve problems involving addition and subtraction
skillName: Addition and Subtraction Word Problems within 20

items.prompt: Nina has 9 apples. She gives 3 to her friend. How many apples does Nina have left?

steps: We are taking away, so subtract.

items.prompt: There are 7 red flowers and 6 yellow flowers in a garden. How many flowers are there in all?

steps: We are putting two groups together, so add.

items.prompt: A box has 14 pencils. A student takes out 5 pencils. How many pencils are still in the box?

steps: We are taking away, so subtract.
There are 9 pencils still in the box.
